decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's established advisory and partnership capabilities, so the firm can interpret its early results and improve the program rather than drop it.
Product B builds on the firm's recycling and feedstock expertise and the firm conducts in-house R&D, enabling it to assimilate new information and further develop the binder.
Product C is close to the firm's existing waste treatment knowledge and the firm has R&D, allowing it to learn from quantified launch results and improve the decontamination plant.
